description: Website metadata scraper: SEO tags, Open Graph, links extractor. Fetch a public web page and return its SEO and sharing metadata (title, description, canonical, language, Open Graph, Twitter card, favicon, robots meta, headings) and its links (internal and external, up to 300). Obeys the site's robots.txt. Price: $0.005 per call (x402, USDC on Base).
